title: Finance Controller for CTO – Global Infrastructure
full_description:
Makati City, Philippines
Location: Makati, PhilippinesWork Schedule: Aligns with Central European Time (CET)Department: CTO Finance – Finance AdvisoryReporting: Functionally to Global Finance COO – Global Infrastructure
About ING and ING Hubs Philippines:
ING Hubs Philippines is an integral part of ING’s global network, delivering services to multiple business units worldwide across Wholesale and Retail Banking. At ING, our purpose is to empower people to stay a step ahead in life and business. We believe sustainable progress is driven by people with imagination and determination to create a better future.
Working at ING means joining a diverse, dynamic environment where challenges are never the same, and opportunities for growth are abundant. If you thrive in a continuously evolving landscape and want to help shape the future of banking, we’d love to meet you!
We are seekingFinance Controller for CTO – Global Infrastructureto join our growing team based in Makati Philippines
In this role, as an extended global finance team,you will connect with diverse stakeholders worldwide, providingfinancial analysis and performance analysis, and decision supportto enable sustainable business growth and operational excellence.
Drive and ensure accurate and timely financial reporting (Global Infrastructure) in compliance with global standards.
Monitor cost charging and allocations, Invoice Analysis, and efficiency metrics.
Support transformation projects and process improvements.
What We’re Looking For
Strong conceptual knowledge offinance and accounting, including SOX Reporting. FP&A backgroundis an advantage as this will have strong interaction with controllers
Highly Technical, Proficiency inPeopleSoft and Excel (Advanced),Power Query and Power BI is plus
Business Acumen,good understanding the Technology and Infrastructure domain, including Software Business
Quality Management,attention to details to ensure reliability of data and drive to continuous improvement to sustain.
Communications Skills, Ability to work with senior leaders and global controllers to drive reliable financial information and reporting.
Global Mindset:Experience in multinational organizations with diverse stakeholders and cross-border collaboration.
Thrives in High-Pressure Environments:Comfortable managing competing priorities and delivering results under tight deadlines.
Analytical Thinking:Skilled in interpreting complex data and presenting clear recommendations.
Communication & Influence:Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.
Adaptability:Comfortable working in a fast-paced, global environment.
Collaboration:Team player with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field, Experience in banking, particularly Retail and Wholesale Banking, is a plus
Professional certifications (CPA, CMA, CFA) are an advantage.
Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in Finance and Accounting, in a multinational Banking and IT company.
Passion for continuous improvement and driving efficiency through automation.
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law.
